subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should WebChat adopt the existing chat.history.inFlightRun recovery contract on reconnect, revive/rewrite PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41067, or declare the current queued-send and Stop-visibility mitigations sufficient for this issue?
rationale: Current source shows partial mitigation but no full WebChat in-flight run adoption; the remaining behavior crosses UI session-state semantics, gateway snapshot contracts, and a stale proof-gated candidate PR.

options.title: Implement current-main WebChat adoption
options.body: Use the existing gateway inFlightRun/active-run contract in WebChat and require focused live reconnect proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Rework the open candidate PR
options.body: Ask the PR author or a maintainer to rebase and narrow PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41067 against current protocol/session contracts with fresh proof.

options.title: Accept partial mitigations only
options.body: Close or split the remaining reports only if maintainers explicitly decide active-run re-adoption is not part of the WebChat reconnect contract.

recommendation.title: Implement current-main WebChat adoption
recommendation.body: Use the existing gateway inFlightRun/active-run contract in WebChat and require focused live reconnect proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work spans the current WebChat/Gateway split and native reconnect adoption paths, making this the best available routing owner for the contract choice.
